Filomena

regarding this ticket i will notify that the current non operation of the charger is related to an error of door position switch and not on EcoG, as visible on the error flags attached. When door is opened or door position switch doesn't work properly, many other errors appear.
We will plan an on site visit soon
Thanks for the support and have a great day
Bye,
Giuseppe
